buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support

Bidder's offer liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the cert ificates /documents sought in the bid document. ATC and corrigenduem if any:- (a) Bidder should upload only required documents as asked in the bid document and ATC in pdf file format with name of documents as file name in one file/ folder. Bidders should not upload multiple copies of the s ame documents. If duplicate/ false documents found at any stage, the bidder will be disqualified. (b) Annual Turn Over to be provided by the bidder duly supported with relevant documents along with ITR of last three financial years. (c) The bidder should not be under liquidation; court receivership or similar proceedings should not be ban krupt. Bidder need to upload non-Blacklisted affidavit on notarized Stamp Paper. (e) Emd is mandatory for the till bid end date and time.

(f) Bidder/Seller must upload GST Cert, PAN Card and cancel cheque. (g) Incident dashboard report of GEM Portal (Screenshot with current date) is mandatory to upload; there s hould not be any current incident and litigation on going on GEM Portal against their organization. (h) Bidder/Seller must upload past performance Certificate. (i) Bidder/Seller must upload all product catalogue with duly signed, stamped and complete specification o n company letter head. If Bidder/Seller not upload catalogue with sign and stamped then it will be conside red as disqualified. (j) ISO 9001:2015 will be uploaded in the Bid. (k) Office address in consignee location for service support with company letter head. (l) All the rights to accept or reject the without assigning any reason will be reserved with this office.
